ABOUT THIS FIELD GUIDE

A place to understand the cloud.

Explore a simplified datacenter, from incoming electricity to the machines that use it and the systems that carry away their heat.

This is an educational model of a mixed air- and liquid-cooled facility. Equipment sizes, placement, redundancy, and animated flows are illustrative. Real designs vary.

Use the chapter buttons or number keys 1–6. Select equipment to see what it does. Drag the world to rotate it; use the wheel to zoom. All equipment is also available as buttons in the lesson.

DESIGN INSPIRATION

The playful, isometric world of Yamauchi No.10. All geometry here is created for this guide.
